title: GDS Cyber - Frontier AI-VMDR - Senior Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Position Tittle: EY GDS – Senior Cyber AI Engineer, Technology Consulting:**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services:**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 As a Senior Cyber AI Engineer within EY's Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will drive the convergence of Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, and Artificial Intelligence to build intelligent, scalable, and automated security operations.
   

  

 You will design, implement, and enhance AI\-enabled vulnerability management programs that leverage machine learning, generative AI, intelligent analytics, and automation to improve risk identification, prioritization, remediation, and executive decision\-making across enterprise environments.
   

  

 In addition to delivering client engagements, you will help shape EY’s AI\-driven Cybersecurity capabilities, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor teams on applying AI responsibly and securely within cyber operations.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As organizations rapidly adopt AI and cloud\-native technologies, cybersecurity teams must evolve beyond traditional vulnerability management approaches. You will help clients transform their security operations by applying AI and data\-driven techniques to vulnerability management lifecycle
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 AI Security \& Guardrails
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise AI security guardrails.
* Develop controls to mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, model abuse, and adversarial attacks.
* Define AI trust, safety, governance, and security standards.
* Evaluate AI applications against organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Establish policies and enforcement mechanisms for responsible AI usage.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for AI applications, agents, and autonomous workflows.
* Define secure deployment patterns for LLM, RAG, and agent\-based solutions.
* Establish security logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities for AI systems.


 AI Red Teaming
   

  

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI\-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI\-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat\-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.


 Engineering \& Automation
   

  

* Develop Python\-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.


**Additional AI Security Skills**
* Application Security (OWASP Top 10\)
* Secure SDLC / DevSecOps
* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management


 Additional Security Frameworks
   

  

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks


**To Qualify for the Role**
**Education**
* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA


**Experience**
* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2\+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs


**Preferred Certifications**
* CEH, CISSP, CISM, OSCP, GIAC, Azure AI, Open AI, AWS ML, Azure ML certifications


**What We Look For**
**Professionals who can bridge the gap between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence by:**
* Building AI\-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next\-generation cyber transformation initiatives.


 The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GDS Cyber - CAOE - Staff - AI IT OT Network and Infrastructure Security
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Staff**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security Staff professional with solution mindset, who understands \& possess knowledge in network security / Infrastructure security concepts, risk and controls concepts, architecture design, transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a staff professional who should have practical experience in network security engineering, detection engineering, and OT cyber risk reduction, with growing exposure to AI\-assisted security operations, prompt engineering, AI\-driven anomaly detection, and device behavior analytics.
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Understands design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Possess knowledge about deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Possess knowledge \& experience on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Good understanding on AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Understands AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 1–3 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.


**Professional understanding \& knowledge of\-**
* OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong interpersonal and customer orientation skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Knowledge of Information security standards and compliances (ISO 27001, ISO 27017, NIST 800 53, NIST 800\-207, CISA, CIS benchmark etc)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

**Typical work environment**
* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

title: Vulnerability Management Analyst
description:
**Vulnerability Management Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We partner with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, more capable AI systems. Now we're looking for experienced security practitioners to bring real\-world vulnerability management expertise to the frontier of AI development.
   

  

 This isn't a typical analyst role. You'll apply your hands\-on knowledge of CVEs, exposure management, and remediation workflows to help train and evaluate AI systems — ensuring they reason about security risk the way seasoned professionals actually do.
   

  

 If you've spent time in the trenches triaging vulnerabilities, managing patch cycles, or prioritizing what actually matters in production environments, your expertise is exactly what we need.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze vulnerability reports, CVEs, and real\-world exposure scenarios across infrastructure and applications
* Assess severity, exploitability, business impact, and appropriate remediation strategies
* Review and evaluate patching, mitigation, and risk prioritization decision\-making scenarios
* Generate, label, and validate realistic security\-reasoning data used to train and benchmark AI systems
* Apply your practical knowledge of what risk actually matters in production — not just theoretical CVSS scores


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience in vulnerability management, security operations, or infrastructure security
* Solid understanding of CVEs, vulnerability scanners, patching workflows, and risk prioritization frameworks
* Able to articulate the real\-world tradeoffs between theoretical risk scores and operational impact
* A structured, analytical thinker who communicates clearly in writing
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with tools like Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar platforms
* Familiarity with frameworks such as CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, or NIST
* Background in cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, or enterprise security operations
* Prior experience contributing to AI, data labeling, or research projects


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on cutting\-edge AI projects with top\-tier research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Make a meaningful contribution to how AI reasons about cybersecurity
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

The role will focus on security architecture reviews, application security governance, cloud security enforcement, AI security oversight, risk remediation, and alignment with enterprise cybersecurity standards.

* Experience partnering with cross\-functional stakeholders including technology, product, risk, compliance, privacy, legal, and business teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical security risks to both technical and non\-technical audiences.

title: Playwright Automation Testing
description:
**The Team** 




  





 Deloitte’s Technology \& Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact\-driven decision\-making and generate an insight\-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence \& visualization, data management, performance management and next\-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.
 



  





**Your work profile** 




  




* We are looking for enthusiastic and detail\-oriented Associate Automation Test Engineers to join our Quality Engineering team.
* This role is suited for engineers who go beyond executing test scripts—those who understand system behaviour, validate integrations end\-to\-end, and take ownership of quality outcomes.



  





**Key skills required** 




  




* **6–9 years of overall software testing/QA experience.**
* Strong hands\-on experience with
 **Playwright automation** 
 .
* Strong programming skills in
 **TypeScript/JavaScript** 
 .
* Strong understanding of Playwright concepts including
* Locators and selectors
* Fixtures
* Browser contexts
* Assertions
* Auto\-waiting
* Network interception/mocking
* Authentication/session management
* Parallel execution
* Trace Viewer and debugging
* Strong experience in UI and end\-to\-end test automation.
* Good experience with
 **REST API testing and API automation** 
 .
* Experience with Git/GitHub/Bitbucket or equivalent source\-control platforms.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD pipelines.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum development and testing practices.
* Strong knowledge of defect lifecycle, test design techniques and regression\-testing strategies.



  





**Education** 




 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
